column1: # Pass 131, 2026-10-11.  Repos verified this pass with GitHub repo search
# (authoritative fields: license.spdx_id, stargazers_count, pushed_at, fork, archived).
# INSTRUMENT NOTE.  `curl -sI https://github.com/<repo>` returns 403 for every URL from this
# runner, real or not (established p130 with a control on a nonexistent repo), so it verifies
# nothing.  api.github.com and the gh CLI search path are blocked for out-of-scope repos.
# Repo search is the working instrument for METADATA.  It cannot read a licence PAYLOAD, and
# that distinction is this pass's finding: see README Pass 131, P131-B.
# held_before = was this address already present on a live page of this KB before p131?
